brief: When a support ticket is filed, a tool checks whether it duplicates one of the open tickets returned by a search over the same product area. Return the ID of the open ticket that describes the same underlying problem, or none when no open ticket matches. A ticket about a related but different symptom, or a question rather than a problem report, is not a duplicate.
input_shape: { new_ticket: string, open_tickets: { id: string, title: string }[] }
